note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: At 1:1 the flag reads soft and out of focus; cross edges and blue sheen are smeared with almost no added detail (detail_gain 3.04). Usage is a 55-unit wall, so this is visible up close.
flags.fix: Sharpen the edge pass and add fine weave or grain on the blue and white fields that matches the original, keeping the exact Union Jack geometry and colours.

flags.problem: At 1:1 the dark round vegetation spots become soft blurry blobs with a blotchy green smear. The overall tint is more saturated green than the grey-green original.
flags.fix: Keep the spot edges crisp (less blur on the low-frequency pass) and reduce the green saturation of the injected layer so it matches the original grey-green ground.

flags.problem: The smooth light-grey sky of the original is replaced by a rock-like marbled or crumpled texture, which is the wrong material for a sky. The 1:1 centre crop also shows blocky stair-step artefacts and horizontal smears.
flags.fix: Restrict the rock-lab-inject step to the dark ground and tree-silhouette area, leave the sky as a smooth gradient, and redo from the pchip upscale without multiplicative injection on the light areas.
